title: US power demand and the AI data-center buildout
discussion_signal: The post frames AI demand as arriving faster than grids, transformers, turbines, transmission, and labor can be delivered. It shifts the discussion from software capability to physical infrastructure sequencing and governance.
linked_research_question: How AI and data-center demand move through electricity, equipment, labor, permitting, and ultimately household cost and reliability exposure.
limits: Professional post relays forecasts and industry claims
No utility tariff, outage, or household bill is measured here
